reconciliationNote: Line labels and requested cents are joined by sovLineId. Suggested cents, verdicts, approved cents, actions and both reasons are copied from the existing stored review and gcDecision rows without edits.

flaggedLines.reviewReason: Line claims 100% to date (100% work in place, note 'Rough-in complete'), but the funded Rough-in tranche covering line 1 supports a ceiling of only 50% to date, so the claim exceeds the tranche ceiling and is capped at 0.5.
flaggedLines.gcReason: Rough-in is complete and the $4,000.00 Rough-in tranche is authorized at PayPal. The 50% tranche ceiling measures funding progress, not work in place, so the GC approves the full $4,000.00 for line 1.

flaggedLines.reviewReason: Line claims 40% to date (40% work in place), but the only tranche covering line 2 (Fixtures set) is planned, not funded, so its ceiling is 0%; the claim of 0.4 exceeds the ceiling and earns 0% this period.
flaggedLines.gcReason: Fixtures set is only 40% in place and the Fixtures set milestone is still planned, so this line is cut by $1,400.00 (140,000 cents), from $1,400.00 to $0.00, until that milestone is funded and the work is complete.
